act.name: Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961
act.source_authority: Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India
act.description: Central law prohibiting giving, taking and demanding dowry and protecting dowry received for a woman's benefit.

sections.title: Penalty for demanding dowry.
sections.text: Section 4 provides punishment for directly or indirectly demanding dowry.
sections.plain_language_summary: A direct or indirect dowry demand from the parties to a marriage or their relatives is punishable.
